lookup.key: GRCh38 genomic variant (chrom, pos, ref_nt, alt_nt) of data/variants_v8.csv

not_queried: rows whose alleles are not a single A/C/G/T substitution (multi-nucleotide substitution, IUPAC ambiguity code, indel) are left unannotated: queried = 0, skip_reason gives the cause
missing_values: NaN (empty cell) wherever a value is not served; nothing is imputed; no row is dropped
R1_multi_transcript_rule: A score served as a list has one value per transcript (transcripts without value dropped, so not aligned with transcript ids); scalars and lists are treated uniformly and the MOST DAMAGING value across transcripts is used: max where higher_is_pathogenic is true, min where it is false. Raw scores only, no rankscores.
R2_several_amino_acid_changes: A genomic variant with several amino-acid changes (overlapping reading frames / genes, or a splice-site row of another transcript) has several dbNSFP rows; MyVariant.info serves the scores of the FIRST row only (dbnsfp.aa[0]). If that row is not the ref1>alt1 change of the variant (dbnsfp_score_aa_match = 0), predictors with masked_if_other_aa_change = true are set to NaN and dbnsfp_scores_masked = 1.
availability_rule: a column exists if at least one retrieved record carries a value at its source path (the field list of /metadata/fields is incomplete and is reported for information)

sc_metarnn.note: uses population allele frequencies as input features

sc_bayesdel_addaf.note: uses population allele frequency as input feature

sc_esm1b.note: log-likelihood ratio; more negative = more deleterious

sc_cadd_phred.note: defined per genomic variant (GRCh38 model), therefore not masked by rule R2

sc_sift4g.note: smaller = more deleterious; separate column, never mixed with sc_sift

sc_clinpred.note: uses population allele frequencies as input features

sift_rule: SIFT and SIFT4G are both served and are given as separate columns (sc_sift, sc_sift4g); SIFT4G is never substituted for a missing SIFT value.

cons_phylop100.aggregation: one value per genomic position; max if several distinct values

cons_phylop_mammal.aggregation: one value per genomic position; max if several distinct values

cons_phylop_primate.aggregation: one value per genomic position; max if several distinct values

cons_phastcons100.aggregation: one value per genomic position; max if several distinct values

cons_gerp_rs.aggregation: one value per genomic position; max if several distinct values

af_gnomad_exome.gnomad_release: gnomAD v2.1.1 exomes, lifted over to GRCh38 (125,748 exomes)

af_gnomad_exome_popmax_derived.meaning: DERIVED max allele frequency over the continental groups afr, amr, eas, nfe, sas (not the official gnomAD popmax / faf95 field, which is not served)
af_gnomad_exome_popmax_derived.gnomad_release: gnomAD v2.1.1 exomes, lifted over to GRCh38 (125,748 exomes)

af_gnomad_genome_popmax_derived.meaning: DERIVED max allele frequency over the continental groups afr, amr, eas, nfe, sas (not the official gnomAD popmax / faf95 field, which is not served)

allele_frequency.af_any: max over the available global AFs (af_gnomad_exome, af_gnomad_genome); NaN if the variant is in none of these gnomAD sources
allele_frequency.af_present: 1 if a global AF exists in at least one gnomAD source, 0 if not, NaN if not queried
allele_frequency.qc_filter: AFs are given whatever the gnomAD QC filter; <object>_filter holds the filter flags ("PASS" = record without filter flag)

bookkeeping.hgvs_id: id that was queried (empty if not queried)
bookkeeping.skip_reason: why a row was not queried
bookkeeping.found: 1 if exactly one document with the queried _id was returned
bookkeeping.has_dbnsfp: 1 if that document has a dbnsfp block whose coordinates agree with the query
bookkeeping.dbnsfp_aa_match: 1 if ANY amino-acid annotation of the dbNSFP record (any dbnsfp.aa row, any dbnsfp.hgvsp string) has ref1 and alt1; 0 if a dbnsfp block exists but none matches; NaN without dbnsfp block
bookkeeping.dbnsfp_score_aa_match: 1 if the first dbnsfp.aa row - the row the served scores belong to - has ref1 and alt1; 0 otherwise; NaN without dbnsfp block
bookkeeping.dbnsfp_aapos_match: 1 if a matching annotation also has amino-acid position ref_pos
bookkeeping.dbnsfp_n_aa_rows: number of dbNSFP rows (distinct amino-acid changes) of the genomic variant
bookkeeping.dbnsfp_aa_annot: amino-acid annotations found: dbNSFP rows separated by "|" (the first one is the row the served scores belong to), transcript positions by "/", "noAA" = row without amino-acid change (splice-site row of another transcript)
bookkeeping.dbnsfp_scores_masked: 1 if rule R2 set the substitution-specific predictors to NaN
bookkeeping.<gnomad object>_filter: gnomAD QC filter of the record, NaN if the variant is not in that source

documents: notfound answers, several documents for one id, a returned _id different from the query and blocks whose own coordinates contradict the query are counted in the summary and never used
